entries.reason: iOS 6 makes the same image with a CIFilter, its input image and the values of its keys
entries.effect: makes the filter of that name with its default values, sets this image as its input image, sets each parameter by its key (so a key the filter does not have raises NSUnknownKeyException, and one that names the input image replaces this image) and gives the output image; nil for a filter that does not exist
entries.source: the host's CoreImage, over the filter name that is unknown, an unknown key, defaults and an input image given in the parameters; an iPad 2 running 6.1.3 for the filters of the release

entries.effect: the output image of the filter of that name with its default values and this image as its input
